reason: DeepRead is primarily a deep-research plugin that analyzes articles, books, PDFs, and document sets into traceable claims, evidence mappings, confidence levels, knowledge maps, and review questions, with optional comparison and export features.

summaries.zh: DeepRead 可对文章、书籍、PDF 和文档集合进行证据追踪式深度阅读，生成摘要、论点与证据映射、置信度、知识图谱及复习问题。
summaries.en: DeepRead performs evidence-traceable analysis of articles, books, PDFs, and document sets, producing summaries, claim-to-evidence mappings, confidence levels, knowledge maps, and review questions.

capabilities: Reads pasted text, local text and PDF files, and supported article URLs
Generates summaries, claims linked to source evidence, confidence levels, knowledge maps, and review questions
Compares batches of documents and identifies conflicts or complementarity
Optionally writes Markdown, HTML, and mindmap exports to the workspace
Maintains local recently-read history and supports background processing for long reads
